big_case.notes: Interlocutory paid petition from a county public defender in a Michigan OWI (marijuana) prosecution, taken before trial after Michigan's appellate courts denied leave without reasoning. The questions presented are a fact question about one driver's notice and a misplaced capable-of-repetition framing, no conflict is asserted, no response was filed, and the denial drew no writing. A national THC-impairment notice rule would matter, but nothing about this vehicle made that outcome live. Read formed before consulting the candidates' own big_case_score values; the outcome (bare denial, one distribution) confirms the low stakes.
